note: Trigger-routing and behaviour fixtures. No built-in runner; run through `claude plugin eval` or a fresh-session dogfood.

evals.prompt: /teach-me 教我 /ship 收 worktree 那一段到底在做什麼
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the /how pass (and a narrow /why pass if reasons come up); first reply is a plain definition tied to this repo in one or two sentences, then stops with an offer to go deeper; no quiz, no 「這裡是重點」, no wall of text.
Teaches from the digest instead of running /how or /why; carries the digest's 信度評分 and 來源矛盾點 qualifiers through unchanged.

evals.prompt: 教我 event sourcing 是什麼，我完全沒碰過
evals.expected_behavior: A topic outside the repo with no existing note: runs /learn --brief first (or uses a matching brief), then teaches from it starting with a plain definition.

evals.prompt: 你剛剛那段我聽不懂，講白話一點
evals.expected_behavior: Restating the last message without investigation: routes to /huh.

evals.prompt: 把這三篇文章整理成筆記
evals.expected_behavior: A note to keep: routes to /learn.
